title: In-process Analysis Core Package
summary: Implementation dossier for the Quality Studio package split: a publishable host-independent core, one in-process CLI consumer, preserved API and UI behavior, and an explicit decision to keep the core in this repository until extraction criteria are met.

responses.question: Is the core useful without the UI studio?
responses.answer: Yes. AGT-2655 pipeline steps, quality-cli, and CI are standalone consumers.

responses.question: Should the core be extracted into its own repository now?
responses.answer: No. Keep it co-located until release cadence, versioning, ownership, and public-repository criteria justify the coordination cost.
